The '''Six Savage Viziers''' ruled the [[Atrisian Empire]] after the death of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Eoaq the Expansive|Eoaq]] the Expansive. Their reign was marked for its sociopathic decadence, reverting most of Eoaq's [[Eoaq reforms|reforms]] with counter-reforms.
